_what: The visual-database views every Trillion list offers beside its own (parts/ui/show/record-views/every-list-views.ts). `kind` is the visual-database view drawn (show/VisualDatabaseSurface.tsx viewRenderers); `progress` draws how much of the list is done above a list view; `needs` names the roles a list's fields must fill for the view to be offered; `wants` names the roles it draws when the list fills them without making them a condition (read-data/visual-database-input-from-list.ts listFieldRoles). Adding a view is one row.

done._what: What marks a list's item done, for every view (the Checklist ticks it, the Outline files it under Completed): a value of a field carrying one of these tones, or named one of these words (without case).
